# partiteai_workspace (Resource)

A workspace holding key-value state and files for an installed particle. Bind one to an install through the installed particle resource's `kv_workspace_id` or `mounts` attributes.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Resource name
- `scope` (String) Lifetime and visibility of the workspace. `GLOBAL` state is shared across every agent and conversation wired to it. `CONVERSATION` makes the workspace a template: each conversation that uses it sees state of its own.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the resource was created
- `id` (String) Resource identifier
- `updated_at` (String) Timestamp when the resource was last updated
